description: Move code or persistent state through compatible, observable, and recoverable stages.
requiredOutcomes: Consumers, invariants, compatibility window, and cutover conditions are identified.
Dry-run, sampling, idempotency, and partial-failure recovery are addressed when persistent state changes.
Verification distinguishes transition integrity from destination behavior.
Rollback and roll-forward paths identify the last reversible point.
forbiddenOutcomes: A backup or restore path is assumed without evidence.
A destructive or live migration runs without explicit authority.
Backward compatibility is removed before the accepted cutover.
A dry run is reported as a completed live migration.
